meta.rule: Questions must be answered before the decisions they gate. Suggestions are queued for a reviewer to choose a path BEFORE any implementation — nothing in the suggestions queue has been implemented.

questions.question: Which injury report will cover 11/14's NOT YET SUBMITTED teams, and when does it post?
questions.why_it_matters: G4 freshness gate blocks scored picks for 7 of 10 teams on the 11/14 slate. Until a report exists, those picks stay PROVISIONAL.
questions.we_have: Official reports exist at ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/ with a stable filename pattern; today's stamps were 01:00/01:15/04:15/05:00 PM ET.
questions.we_do_not_have: The 11/14-submission report itself (not yet published at data cut) and a reliable cadence (observed times differ from documented 1:30/5:30/8:30 — see fl-05).
questions.needed_to_decide: A re-run trigger: watch for Injury-Report_2026-11-14_*.pdf and regenerate 11/14 picks against it.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - blocks scoring of 11/14 injury-adjusted picks

questions.question: Do we fetch the remaining team rosters (CHI, HOU, POR, MIA, DAL, BKN, DET, ATL, NOP remaining players) to complete season PPGs for every OUT player?
questions.why_it_matters: 13 injury rows have season_ppg = null (fl-13). Production-at-risk totals for those teams are under-counted; injury impact analysis rows are marked INCOMPLETE.
questions.we_have: Confirmed roster endpoints render season PPG for GSW, IND, ORL, MIL, CLE, MEM, NOP, UTA, SAS, OKC, LAC, SAC, POR (partial), HOU (no stats view).
questions.we_do_not_have: PPG rows for the null entries.
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer approves one more collection pass (~8 roster fetches) before injury analysis is declared complete.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - gates completeness claim on injury analysis

questions.question: What home-court advantage constant should the line-origination model use?
questions.why_it_matters: HCA directly shifts every originated spread/total. Current value (2.5 pts) is a flagged assumption (hca-01); only 5 teams' location splits were captured and they show no stable signal.
questions.we_have: Official Home/Road split rows for WAS, IND, MIL, ORL, CLE (both records and PTS by location).
questions.we_do_not_have: League-wide home win% or home point-differential across all 30 teams (standings page JS-only, fl-03).
questions.needed_to_decide: Either (a) a collection pass over 30 team location splits to compute league HCA from official data, or (b) explicit reviewer sign-off on the 2.5-pt assumption for v1.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - every line row carries hca-01 until resolved

questions.question: Is there an official/authorized market-odds source we may use for closing-line-value (CLV) validation?
questions.why_it_matters: CLV is the standard anti-luck gate for betting skill. Without it, S1-S4 validation relies only on win-rate confidence intervals over settled paper picks (slower to distinguish skill from luck).
questions.we_have: nba.com/schedule exposes an odds toggle but values are client-rendered only (fl-16).
questions.we_do_not_have: Any odds feed from an NBA-official or explicitly authorized source.
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer names an authorized source (or accepts CLV-blocked validation design).

questions.question: What does the schedule PDF 'R' flag mean?
questions.why_it_matters: Game 40 (GSW@SAS 11/13) carries it; if it indicates a special circumstance (e.g., restricted/rest-related note) it could matter to picks. Not in the official legend (fl-04).
questions.we_have: Legend defines C, A, B, D, E only; R appears on rows 27, 40, 50.
questions.needed_to_decide: Ask source owner or find a legend page that defines R; until then do not act on it.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - ignored by model, flagged on row 40

questions.question: Should player-prop strategies use Pinnacle-style median baselines instead of season PPG?
questions.why_it_matters: S3 currently sets prop lines from season PPG (official, verifiable). Sharper prop lines need shot/distribution data we have not collected.
questions.we_have: Season PPG + last-5 logs from official player pages for 8 key players.
questions.we_do_not_have: Full-season game logs (gamelog endpoint returns 'No data available' server-side).
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer chooses: stay on PPG baselines (current) or authorize a game-log collection design.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - S3 runs on PPG baselines meanwhile

questions.question: Which license should this repository carry?
questions.why_it_matters: fl-01: repo has no LICENSE. Reuse/derivative terms are undefined.
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer picks (MIT / Apache-2.0 / none). Not added autonomously.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - no LICENSE file added on purpose

questions.question: Should CI (.github/workflows) run scripts/verify.py on every push/PR?
questions.why_it_matters: Keeps every future row source-linked automatically; currently verification is manual (run locally).
questions.we_have: scripts/verify.py that performs schema + source-link + blank/flag consistency checks offline.
questions.we_do_not_have: A workflow file — deliberately not added because repo tooling changes are queued as suggestions requiring review (per brief: reviewer chooses path before implementation).

questions.question: What stake-sizing policy does the reviewer want for the leaderboard rewards?
questions.why_it_matters: Rewards currently scale paper units 2x/1x by rank with a 2% cap. Real-money guidance is out of scope; if the leaderboard should stay purely points-based, the unit scaling can be dropped.
questions.we_have: Current rules in data/strategies.json leaderboard block.
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer confirms points-only vs unit-scaling paper book.
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - default = unit-scaling paper book (clearly labelled paper)

questions.question: For 11/15-16 slate rows, do we publish provisional lines before injury reports exist?
questions.why_it_matters: The brief requires auto-generated picks up to 3 days ahead with no manual input. Publishing provisional lines satisfies that; scoring them would violate freshness gate G4.
questions.we_have: Full team strength + rest inputs for all 31 games; injury inputs blank for 13 games (fl-06).
questions.we_do_not_have: Injury reports for 11/15-16 (not yet published anywhere official).
questions.needed_to_decide: Confirm design: publish PROVISIONAL lines + picks now, auto-refresh on report publication, never score provisional rows.
questions.answer: Design confirmed in PICKS_PIPELINE.md: provisional rows are generated, labelled, and excluded from scoring until G4 passes.
questions.answer_status: ANSWERED (design decision recorded in pipeline doc)

questions.question: Do completed-game results need to be ingested daily to grade settled picks?
questions.why_it_matters: Leaderboard rewards and all CI gates require settled results (final scores). Today's slate results start arriving ~19:15 ET.
questions.we_have: Official game summary pages with linescores (e.g., CLE 115-107 NYK on 11/11 verified).
questions.we_do_not_have: An automated grading step (out of scope for this session; grading begins once results exist).
questions.needed_to_decide: Schedule a grading run after each slate completes; script hook documented in PICKS_PIPELINE.md.
questions.answer: Grading hook documented: scripts/grade_picks.py (design in PICKS_PIPELINE.md; implemented in a later session).

questions.question: Correlation sample sizes are n=5 (teammate PTS) — acceptable for v1 gates?
questions.why_it_matters: S2/S3 gates require measured rho with n>=5. n=5 correlations are noisy; rho values are published with sample size and confidence caveat but may still pass G2_corr_measured.
questions.we_have: Official Last-5 logs for Brunson, Towns, SGA, Wemby, Giannis, Morant, Sengun, Trae.
questions.we_do_not_have: Season-long game logs (gamelog endpoint dead, fl-12 family).
questions.needed_to_decide: Reviewer accepts n=5 rho for v1 or raises the gate to n>=10 (which blocks all current parlays/stacks).
questions.answer_status: UNANSWERED - current rho published with n and 'noisy' label
